description: This PHP source file defines the SaveEmployeeController class, which extends AbstractVueController. It handles pre-rendering logic for an employee save component within an HR management system. The class configures properties related to employee ID, allowed image types, and password requirements, utilizing services for ID generation and social media authentication.

classes.name: SaveEmployeeController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing the employee save component with necessary properties such as employee ID, allowed image types, and password requirement based on social media authentication status.

methods.name: getIdGeneratorService
methods.description: Returns the IDGeneratorService instance, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by adding relevant properties like employee ID, allowed image types, and password requirement flag.
